Which system should you choose?

If sound quality is the priority, I'd lean toward Sony's Mobile ES range or a higher-end Kenwood Excelon receiver, paired with quality speakers, an amplifier and a subwoofer. For a straightforward touchscreen upgrade, the Sony XAV-AX6000 is my first choice.

One question: Are you looking for a complete car sound system (speakers, subwoofer, amplifier), or just a touchscreen stereo/head unit?

Also, what is your car's make, model and year? That determines which stereos will fit and whether factory features can be retained.
